en: Congratulations, you did it. You finished
this course. And therefore,
you learned a lot about AI workflows and
agents and how the 2 things are related,
where they overlap. And most importantly,
you saw plenty of examples of workflows and
agents that you could build on your own with
your own code.
And that's therefore what I really would
recommend you to do.
Build your own workflows and agents. Look
for some problem you have in your day-to-day
life, some task you maybe can automate away,
and build a workflow that uses AI if it
makes sense. Of course, not all workflows
need AI, but look for problems that could be
solved with AI and start building workflows,
possibly also autonomous agents that have
multiple tools. But as you learn in this
course, really try to pick the best
solution, which could be an agent with
multiple tools, but which could also be
multiple AI-powered steps working together.
Do that, apply your knowledge, practice what
you learned,
and you'll soon be able to build your own
complex or simple workflows and agents and
solve any kind of problem with AI if it
makes sense.
